image_notes: python 3.12: where the CI runs the checks and the project's Dockerfile both use it
command:
bash -c set -e
export GITHUB_OUTPUT=/tmp/github_output GITHUB_ENV=/tmp/github_env GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY=/tmp/github_step_summary GITHUB_PATH=/tmp/github_path
cd /work
pytest --maxfail=1 --disable-warnings
scope: the whole job, without its tests that need a container runtime
notes: left out, it needs a container runtime (tests/integration/conftest.py imports testcontainers): the sandbox has none and never gets the host's Docker socket: pytest -m integration --maxfail=3 --disable-warnings --junitxml=test-results-integration.xml
